2. Training Summary

Andy Ramos and I conducted orientation and ladder, fall protection, and aerial lift training for seven employees on October 20, 2026. Andy and I brought bread and iced tea for the class, and the participants had a chance to get their snacks before we began. We started in the training room with the orientation and the aerial lift booklet, and the participants completed their paperwork during the session.

We then moved on to the hands-on portion for fall protection and ladder safety. Each participant put on a harness, and I had them show me they could use it correctly: placing the chest strap across the chest and positioning the D-ring between the shoulder blades. They also inspected the lanyard and the self-retracting lifeline (yo-yo) as part of their pre-use equipment checks. For ladder safety, the participants practiced using three points of contact on an A-frame ladder, made sure the ladder was properly locked, and inspected the ladder before use.

The aerial lift hands-on portion was not part of today's session. Today covered the booklet only, and the hands-on training will be completed on site.
